title: Avoid words that are too vague

body.text: Words like 'nice' or 'good' don't help — they're not measurable. Replace them with
, e.g. replace 'fun' with 'fast tempo, punchy drums.' Being specific makes results repeatable and easy to refine.

example: Pop-rock, fast tempo 130 BPM, heavy electric guitar, positive energy, good for workout motivation
